text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — ran a multi-region PrivateLink + IAM stress sim against ap-southeast-1 and eu-west-1 GPU pools this morning, wanted to surface what we saw.
Priya Patel: curious — was this the 'burst-connection' scenario from the runbook? :eyes:
Alex Chen: yeah, 30k short-lived connections per minute over the privatelink endpoints while reprovisioning 120 GPU nodes in parallel. We intentionally mixed cross-account AssumeRole calls to exercise policy checks.
Luc Martinez: TL;DR?
Alex Chen: short: NAT/network state + firewall conntrack surged -> some nodes failed to finish bootstrap because KMS decrypts timed out. Audit logs ballooned (CloudTrail+VPCFlow) and S3 put costs spiked in the eu bucket.
Nadia: oof. Any KMS error logs or error codes?
Alex Chen: we saw repeated KMS throttling 400s and transient AccessDenied from AssumeRole chains. Example: `error="AccessDenied" keyId=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789:key/abcd` and a lot of `KMSRequestThrottled` in a 5m window.
Devon R: did the privatelink endpoint policy block anything or rate-limit at all?
Alex Chen: endpoint policy didn't block, but the interface endpoints' ENIs were being churned by the control plane due to too many concurrent CreateNetworkInterface ops. That churn caused brief DNS resolution glitches for the privatelink alias which aggravated AssumeRole retries.
ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-2145 — privatelink stress test caused KMS decrypt latencies and provisioning timeouts.
Priya Patel: how many GPU boots failed vs succeeded?
Alex Chen: about 14 of 120 nodes failed bootstrap and retried; the rest booted with 30–90s additional latency. The failed ones ultimately came up after we scaled back connection rate.
Luc Martinez: cost impact estimate?
Alex Chen: rough: 2.4x normal CloudTrail PUT volume for the 30m test, ~€420 extra S3 storage+requests in eu-west-1, and extra KMS requests (paid tier) ~0.6k USD. Need exact numbers from billing.
Nadia: can we mitigate immediately if this happens in prod?
Devon R: immediate playbook ideas: 1) throttle provisioning burst using fairshare; 2) temporarily switch privatelink traffic to a regional NAT path that has higher conntrack capacity; 3) enable KMS client-side caching where safe; 4) reduce CloudTrail verbosity for the test account.
Alex Chen: did a quick test of client-side KMS caching on an exemplar node — decrypted bootstrap secrets from local cache eliminated ~85% of KMS calls during retry loops. Will need security signoff for caching TTL.
Priya Patel: On audit: we can't drop CloudTrail retention for prod. But for stress tests we can use a dedicated account + lower S3 lifecycle tier and shorter retention window to avoid cost surprises.
Luc Martinez: action items?
Alex Chen: filing them here: 
- Alex: open a short PR to add per-region provisioning rate-limit (fairshare) and a toggle for 'stress-mode' privatelink optimization (ttl for dns, nic warmpool).
- Devon: evaluate conntrack limits on our firewall appliances and propose a scaling plan.
- Nadia: write a KMS-caching security rubric (TTL, revalidation, key usage constraints).
- Priya: billing owner — estimate exact delta and advise on test-account logging policy.
Devon R: note — firewall vendor says conntrack can be expanded but needs reboots in ap-southeast-1; timeline ~4h maintenance window.
Nadia: on caching: we should require envelope keys for bootstrap secrets and keep direct KMS calls for root-ops. Will draft.
Alex Chen: workaround we applied: slowed node creation to 10 nodes/min, reattached privatelink endpoints to a secondary subnet with more ENI headroom, and redirected CloudTrail to a test bucket with lifecycle policy. All failed nodes recovered after ≈18m.
Luc Martinez: nice. Any followups with infra-security team or vendor?
Priya Patel: i'll loop in infra-sre and the firewall vendor. @Devon R please confirm maintenance window and we'll coordinate.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance created for ap-southeast-1 firewall scaling — MNT-2026-317 at 2026-10-12T02:00Z.
Devon R: confirming, i'll set a tentative 4h window and send calendar invites.
Alex Chen: one more datapoint — we saw CRL/OCSP latencies spike briefly for cert checks on the ENIs, probably from the same egress congestion. Worth adding cert-retry jitter in the runtime.
Nadia: added to KMS/cert rubric.
Priya Patel: thanks everyone. If no objections i'll mark the incident as "post-test ops" and track the PRs. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: no objections. tagging this thread in the runbook (runbook/privatelink-stress-tests) and will paste a condensed postmortem later.
deploy-bot: Deploy note: PR #4482 (rate-limit provisioning) created by Alex Chen, CI passed.
Luc Martinez: great, we'll review the PR and prioritize the firewall scaling work for next sprint. :rocket:
